title: Don’t buy this
text: Don’t buy this. First of all it’s unseasoned, which is a pain in the butt. Second of all the waffles come out super thin so you might as well just make pancakes. If you’re looking to clean it after use, forget about it, you’ll never get it clean.

product_metadata.title: Lot45 Cast Iron Waffle Maker Pan - 6in Stove Top Waffle Iron Cookware, Portable Camping Breakfast Maker for Stovetop
features: [Cook Your Craft]: Dish up some mouth-watering waffles using the Lot45 Waffle Maker Cast Iron 6in while sitting around the campfire

[Practice Make Perfect]: Fill up 1 lid of the stovetop waffle iron with batter; Close both lids and flip waffle pan over to cook; We recommend cooking using pot holders while cooking; Batter and pot holder not included
[For Your Flames]: Use a campfire, gas stove, or 2-burner camp stove when cooking breakfast with this camping cast iron waffle maker

[Quality You Need]: Molded from cast iron to allow for even distribution and retention of heat; Lightweight construction lets you transport stove top waffle maker pan with ease; Cast iron comes unseasoned
[Perfect Size]: Cast iron camp waffle maker measures 6 inches (15cm) in diameter to make small grid waffles; Handle measures approximately 4 inches (10cm)
description: After spending the night stargazing at the campground, cook up some fresh thin-pocket waffles in the morning with the Lot45 Single Waffle Maker. Handle design allows you to hang the camping waffle iron on the wall in your RV or camper kitchen. First pour your waffle batter into 1 lid, and ensure that all sections are full of batter. Then, close the lid, and flip over the cast iron camping waffle maker. Place waffle cast iron maker on your campfire, gas stove, or 2-burner camp stove. Once your waffle is cooked, flip waffle iron back over and remove your waffle with utensils. With a 4-inch handle, cast iron waffle maker camping cookware can fit on most small stovetops. Camp waffle iron is lightweight so you can transport it to and from the lake, campground, and other camping destinations.
